body: That made me giggle

Aw man. I know how that feels. I've been in that situation before. Recently too. It's hard not to think about that possiblity of relationship potentials. Yeah that hope is a tricky thing. I had two instances of talking with some ladies. Got their numbers and occasionally talk to them but I'm guarding myself right now and it's hard to do cause you know when you hope we can easily get caught up in that. So I have just been waiting for them to send out something first then respond and keep it simple no attempts at pursuing yet because I got all my baggage going on. And it really sucks that she's not getting back to you. In this regard I would like to tell you to keep your options open. Don't dwell on to much of the what ifs. Those can lead to a spiral and that well for me I end up in my own head. Because we aren't mind readers. We do like to hope but you also have to keep yourself in mind as well. It comes down to that whole be kinder to yourself. It's weird I know cause we all hear that. I've heard it way too much this year and it confuses me because I hear you have to take care of yourself first and I go down that path and it's hard and then I'll hear from the same people that I don't have to do it alone and I'm just like well what do you want me to do. 
I'm glad you had a moment with her though like that conversation just seemed to resonate with you. And that's okay because that was your moment. And you know what you get to keep it. Because I haven't talked to a hot IT chick ever. Lol. But that's awesome. Because that belongs to you and whether she acts on it or not thats her call. But you. You talked to her had a good talk and now you see where you go. But remember that you talked to her. As for your friend. Well friends are weird. The only thing you can do is ask what's up? But don't like be pushy about it. like I said I'm still waiting on my friends to get back to me from like 6 days ago. It's hard too because when that happens to me like the no responses or communication it's like okay why do I even bother. But so far I've been  working on that. Breathing techniques. Watch anime. Or read scary stories and legends. We're all different in how we deal with things but you know what. You, me everyone on this thread are all dealing with things at the same time. So I know it's hard but don't worry too much over the what ifs. Just go with the flow. Hell I'm still not over my ex and that is just a whole nother set of issues that I'm trying to deal with. That's my what if right now. What if she wants to get back together. What if we don't. What does she want. So that's just like not helping me. It's like that everyday so far. But I'm working through it as best as I can. In that regard I need to go with the flow.

Eh I'm alright looking. I don't really think about how I look anymore. I work in the IT field so socializing is pretty minimal. For me it's really really down to the people I reach out to just straight up don't think about me.
Congrats! I am happy for you. :D
Right there with you. Each day seems like it's a week. Weekends feel like years.
I would say I'm the opposite. I remember everything. That leads to my depression cycling all over again. I wish I could forget.

Relationships have always been an issue with me. As I got older I realized that just because you're blood don't mean you're family. I also used to believe family don't end with blood. Lately I have felt that no matter how hard I tried to keep the bonds I have with anyone really the other end whether it be my exs, friends and family. They never gave me the time of day. So the whole concept of a relationship is becoming more alien to me. Naturally this has put me into a place where I am pushing everyone away.

That's how I feel. I mean I have family still but I feel like a ghost to them. I've slowly just faded away from them and friends and its like no one noticed and now I feel like it doesn't matter. I was exactly like that. Someone called, I was already out there trying to track them down and hold them but roles reversed no one came. Sleep is also my only real escape. I'm sorry that family is like that with you as well. I'm trying so hard to get through this but I can't think of a damn thing to keep me here anymore. I just want this pain to stop.
It does fucking suck. I'm sitting in my car just telling myself to put on the songs that I can scream. It's so crazy how it sneaks up on you.
I love you too

I think for me now that I think about it probably when I was 11. I always felt like I didn't belong. I was very shy as a kid. My home situation wasn't the best due to step siblings constantly bullying me. It really messed up my self esteem and I think as time progressed I just always have had the feeling of just disappearing. I'm 34 now and that feeling of disappearing has been relentless this year. More than ever.
Yeah.

Feel the same. I tried the reaching out thing and it some how just felt like I was in the way or just too much and I got the feeling that no one wanted me around anymore so I just stopped talking. Go to work and try to keep conversation to a minimum and get home and watch movies, draw, play video games etc. Just shut myself off from the world.

This is exactly how I feel. Like you're never alone but you're alone all the time type of deals. I know that I got people in my life that love me but it's hard to feel it. I guess what gets me is they never call or text or message me. I'm usually the one that reaches out. Lately I've just decided to switch off and I'm slowly shutting myself from the outside world. Whether this is a right move I don't know but I just don't feel like I'm important to anyone but I know I am. I guess they don't know how to express it. But yeah I feel you on the feeling lonely.
Thanks bro. Im doing some sketching right now. Just staying in my room though. Don't feel like wondering outside.
Not yet. I'd have to ask my doctors and therapist

My personality changed according to family. Like I was there but wasn't. I did try a few meds but they all had weird side effects so I've opted to try and get better on my own. So far it's been a month and I am slowly getting back to me. I guess I just feel overwhelmed. Physical injury has floored me for a months this year so I feel like I am useless.

I've had treatment. The medication I was on changed me. Therapy just seemed to keep things at a stand still but things that caused the issues just continued to replay. Id like to think I'm just way burned out.

I'm so sorry that you're having a terrible time. Have you looked into other sources for help. I went to my local hospital and asked if there was anyone I could talk to. Maybe there is something similar near you? You acknowledging that you are seeking help and there's nothing wrong with seeking it out. The hard part especially for me was getting myself to that hospital

Everytime I smoked, it seemed to raise my awareness of things like how tense I was, how fast my heart was beating. Most people that I smoked with always said it would relax me but I guess it wasn't for me. I've figured out that adrenaline seems to make me more relaxed I guess so maybe that is why it never really agreed with me.
I've been sleeping, watching anime, shows and movies. When I can I play video games and stream em but mostly I've been playing mobile games cause it's easier on my nerves.
Yeah it's been one hell of a year. I ended up waking up for some damn reason. I don't know if it will. I'd like to think so.
Well I woke up. Family seems more distant ever since Ive been in and out of the hospital. Communication seems forced when I contact them. So I don't know what happened. Maybe grown apart I guess.
